story.title: Built around your outdoor space.
story.p1: MUZALLAT SIKDAR is a Kuwait-based company specialising in pergolas, car parking shades, awnings, steel structures and stage doors.
story.p2: We believe shade structures should be as considered as the buildings they serve. That means designing for the site, choosing suitable materials and finishes, and paying attention to detail in how each structure is made and installed.
story.p3: Whether it is a villa driveway, a garden terrace or a commercial frontage, we work with you from the first idea to the finished structure.

items.title: Design-led
items.text: We start from the site and the way you will use it, then shape the structure around that.

items.title: Crafted with care
items.text: Clean lines and tidy detailing matter to us as much as strength does.

items.title: Clear communication
items.text: You can reach us directly by phone or WhatsApp at any stage of your project.
